{{Quote|FORWARD SHIELD GENERATORS ALREADY 20 PERCENT OVER SPECIFIED CAPACITY. MIY'TARIS ARE NOT DESIGNED TO TAKE HEAVY FIRE.|Ninette, to Ben Skywalker and Tahiri Veila|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
The '''Miy'tari Scout''' was a [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapan]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] model. They had capacity for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a passenger and also an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]. They were equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] and [[vector plate]]s and were armed with [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Tahiri Veila]], accompanied by the [[R9-series astromech droid]] [[Ninette]], flew a Miy'tari Scout to the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] while searching for the missing [[Quest Knights|Quest Knight]] [[Ohali Soroc]].<ref name="Crucible" />
{{Ship-stub}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
The Miy'tari Scout appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
